text: One cell changed at nine p.m. By morning, it had broken ten places in three files.
It's in the memo. The model. Slide four of the deck.
Miss one, and your lender sees two different numbers.
So you hunt, file by file, line by line. Or you ask a chatbot... and it hands you a to-do list.
Now imagine changing it once, and watching every file catch up, waiting only for your OK.
That's Agentic Office. Your Word, Excel and PowerPoint files in one workspace, with an assistant that does the fixing.
Tell it what changed. It finds every place that number lives, and drafts each fix.
Nothing changes without you. Every edit is marked, in the memo, the model and the deck. Accept it, or reject it.
Your team's assistants share what they know, and hand off the work. Only a person says yes.
Ten places. Three files. One review.
Agentic Office. Change it once. Every file follows.
